headline: EPACK Durable releases investor presentation to the exchange

Investors can review the presentation for operational details and strategic insights. The release provides transparency on recent performance for current and prospective shareholders.
why_it_matters: Provides company strategy updates for EPACK shareholders

headline: EPACK Durable initiates voluntary strike-off for two non-operational subsidiaries
summary: EPACK Durable Limited has announced the initiation of a voluntary strike-off for two of its non-operational wholly owned subsidiaries: Bumjin India Audio Products Private Limited and EPACK Electronic Component Private Limited. The closure affects only inactive units and does not alter the parent company's core manufacturing operations. Such routine corporate cleanups of dormant entities have a negligible impact on consolidated financials. Indian retail investors tracking the company need not adjust their thesis based on this procedural filing.
why_it_matters: No material impact on company valuation or shareholder returns.

summary: EPACK Durable Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. headline: Epack Durable submits September quarter SEBI compliance certificate
hook: Routine regulatory filing for Epack Durable
summary: Epack Durable has submitted its standard SEBI compliance certificate for the quarter ending September. The filing is a procedural regulatory requirement for listed companies in India.
